verdict.rationale: doola documents its own Registered Agent service, which offers a separate public-facing business address and digital access to physical mail through the dashboard. Nothing in the evidence shows a founder can buy it as a standalone online purchase, or that it provides the exact agent name and street address for a formation or change filing, let alone on the same day. missing for 10: standalone online purchase flow for registered-agent service, documented delivery of the exact agent name and street address for filings, same-day turnaround, independent or hands-on corroboration.
